reports.title: Impinj Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Outlook
section:
Revenue | $104.0 to $107.0
GAAP Net income | $1.2 to $2.7
Adjusted EBITDA income | $19.2 to $20.7
GAAP Weighted-average shares — diluted | 31.8 to 32.0
GAAP Net income per share — diluted | $0.04 to $0.08
Non-GAAP Net income | $17.6 to $19.1
Non-GAAP Weighted-average shares — diluted(1) | 32.5 to 32.7
Non-GAAP Net income per share — diluted(1) | $0.55 to $0.60

(1) Non-GAAP diluted net income per share includes the impact of our convertible debt, using the if-converted method, which assumes conversion at the beginning of a period and full share settlement. Interest expense of $0.4 million is added back to Non-GAAP net income of $17.6 to $19.1 million then divided by 32.5 to 32.7 million Non-GAAP diluted weighted average shares.
A reconciliation between GAAP and non-GAAP financial measures is provided in the “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” section below.
